Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks for the quick follow-up on the order form. Attached are two files: OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (our annotated changes) and Subproc_Proofs.zip (attestations from our tier-2 vendor, DataStream Inc). High level: CloudCorp needs confirmation that Redwood will accept the proposed flow-down scope for the subcontractor (DataStream) limited to logging/ingestion only, plus DPA routing to our legal team for countersignature.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood confirm the delegation clause in Section 6.3 is acceptable as redlined?
- We requested an explicit data segregation sentence (see p.4 redline) — is that deployable within Redwood Private/Dedicated?
- We will need a short evidence packet (SOC2/attestation, network diagram) — Subproc_Proofs.zip includes a self-attestation and certificate.

Sophie
Sophie Lane
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudCorp

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Order form + subproc flowdown — redlines attached

Thanks Sophie — received and reviewed the redlines at a high level. Forwarding to Laura/legal for textual updates and Monica for evidence verification. A few notes from the infra/ops side before legal confirms: 

- Scope: limiting DataStream to logging/ingest-only is workable provided they are treated as a non-production, write-only KV for a 30-day buffer. Monica, can you validate that the current private deployment supports the logical segregation CloudCorp wants? If not, we'll propose a compensating control.
- Redline on Section 6.3: Our standard delegation accepts subprocessor flow-down with same DPA obligations; Laura, redlines on indemnity/notice timing look potentially problematic — CloudCorp's version shortens our review window to 3 business days. Recommend 10 business days for notice+assessment.
- Evidence: the Subproc_Proofs.zip is a good start, but procurement/legal typically asks for a signed attestation on company letterhead and either SOC2 Type II or a third-party penetration test summary. Sophie, can you get DataStream to provide a signed ILAA/attestation?

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Laura to propose a compromise redline for 6.3 (notice window + scope language) and an explicit sentence for data segregation.
2) Monica to confirm technical feasibility and list any compensating controls.
3) Supply DocuSign link and final attachments for countersign; we will not route DPA until evidence checklist is cleared.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Thanks — I tracked edits directly in OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf and attached a short packet for CloudCorp legal to consider. Key legal positions:

- Notice window: we can accept 7 business days for initial triage, with an escalation path if CloudCorp asserts criticality. Proposed language: 
  "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to review and respond to any proposed subprocessor delegation notice within seven (7) business days; where immediate mitigation is required, the Parties will engage the escalation procedure in Appendix B."

- Flow-down scope: we will accept a limited flow-down to DataStream for "log ingestion and transient buffering only". We will require: (i) written attestation on vendor letterhead; (ii) access restrictions (no analytics access to PII); (iii) retention caps (30 days) — see attached CCPA_Audit_Log_Sample.csv for an example retention report we can produce on request.

- DPA routing: CloudCorp legal must countersign the DPA. Once the evidence packet is complete (SOC2/attestation or equivalent), Redwood's legal will countersign via DocuSign. I left a placeholder for DocuSign in the Order Form (DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/share/EXAMPLE-DocuSignLink-DC8342).

Sophie — could you confirm DataStream can provide: SOC2/Type II OR a third-party pen test report + a signed attestation? If they can only provide the attestation, we'll accept it for initial go-live but will require SOC2 within 90 days as a condition of the delegation.

Attachments referenced: OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (redlines embedded), CCPA_Audit_Log_Sample.csv (example export).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
